pitchDeckTypes.title: Which pitch deck do you want to generate?
pitchDeckTypes.subtitle: Each kind follows the order and slides its audience expects.
pitchDeckTypes.hint: Generation starts right away and takes a few minutes.

errors.create: The pitch deck could not be created. Please try again.

investor.name: Fundraising
investor.description: The classic deck to convince investors: market, traction, team, amount sought.
investor.useWhen: Meeting a business angel, a seed fund or a venture capital fund.

bank.name: Bank financing
bank.description: Present your loan request: financing plan, repayment capacity, guarantees.
bank.useWhen: Applying for credit with a bank or a microfinance institution.

sales.name: Sales presentation
sales.description: Show a customer what they gain: quantified benefits, references, offers and next steps.
sales.useWhen: Sales meeting, answer to a prospect, product demo.

partnership.name: Partnership proposal
partnership.description: Explain what each side brings, what each side gains and how the collaboration works.
partnership.useWhen: Distributor, key account, NGO or institution you want to team up with.

competition.name: Competitions and incubators
competition.description: Convince a jury: impact, feasibility, milestones and exactly how the funds will be used.
competition.useWhen: Startup competition, incubator application, grant request.

elevator.name: Express pitch
elevator.description: Six slides for three minutes: problem, solution, market, traction and the ask.
elevator.useWhen: Demo day, stage pitch, quick first contact.
